[P2] Check newly discovered SDK requests against frozen closures

If cleanup discovers a `DISPATCHED` SDK request after the invocation's frozen `wrapper_return` but before its original `observationEndedAtMs`, the expanded snapshot can pass `validate_retirement_evidence`, which disables `no_late_dispatch`. This call then validates only the original evidence, allowing `PASSED` despite the admission-closure violation. Validate newly discovered requests against the frozen closure boundaries and retain any resulting failure. Add a regression with an otherwise valid cleanup snapshot containing such a dispatch.
